cards.card_text: Then God names the ten peoples whose land it is, from the Kenites to the Jebusites, and yes, the Amorites are on the list.
cards.verse_text: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites, Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites, Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.”
cards.snippet: …of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites, Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites, Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.”

cards.card_text: God will bring them up to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey, the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: …milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: A land flowing with milk and honey, home to the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: And when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites—the land He swore to your fathers that He would give you, a land flowing with milk and honey—you shall keep this service in this month.
cards.snippet: …brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites—the land He swore to your fathers that He would give you, a…

cards.card_text: Then God names the land His angel will bring them into: the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.
cards.snippet: …you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.

cards.card_text: God says He will send an angel ahead of them and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: And I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: …and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says, "Observe what I command you this day." And He promises, "I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites."
cards.verse_text: I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: …will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: Then they run down who lives where: Amalekites in the Negev, Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites in the hill country, and Canaanites by the sea and along the Jordan.
cards.verse_text: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.”
cards.snippet: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by…

cards.card_text: He says the LORD will drive out many nations before them: the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—
cards.snippet: …out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—

cards.card_text: Moses names them: the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: For you must devote them to complete destruction—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—as the LORD your God has commanded you,
cards.snippet: …must devote them to complete destruction—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—as the LORD your God has commanded you,

cards.card_text: Joshua calls everybody in to hear the words of the LORD their God: here's how you'll know the living God is among you and will surely drive out the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: So Joshua told the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.” He continued, “This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that He will surely drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: …drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, Jebusites: every one of their kings hears it.
cards.verse_text: Now when news of this reached all the kings west of the Jordan—those in the hill country, the foothills, and all along the coast of the Great Sea toward Lebanon (the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites)—
cards.snippet: …the Great Sea toward Lebanon (the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites)—

cards.card_text: Out west, the land runs from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, hill country, foothills, wilderness and the Negev, the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: And these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered beyond the Jordan to the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel, Joshua gave them as an inheritance the hill country, the foothills, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites): the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Bethel, one; the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one; the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one; the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one; the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one; the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one; the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one; the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one; the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one; the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one; the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one; the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one; the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one; the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one; the king of Dor in Naphath-dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one; and the king of Tirzah, one.
cards.snippet: …and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites): the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near…

cards.card_text: The south runs from the Salt Sea past Kadesh-barnea to the Brook of Egypt, the east is the Salt Sea, the north climbs right past the Jebusites at Jerusalem, and the west is the Great Sea.
cards.verse_text: From there the border went up the Valley of Ben-hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) and ascended to the top of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
cards.snippet: …went up the Valley of Ben-hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) and ascended to the top of the hill that…

cards.card_text: Judah's northern border runs right past Jerusalem, where the Jebusites live.
cards.verse_text: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: True or false: When this was written, the Jebusites still lived in Jerusalem among the descendants of Judah.
cards.verse_text: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: The Jebusites are living in Jerusalem, and they need to be driven out.
cards.verse_text: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: The Benjamites drive the Jebusites out of Jerusalem.
cards.verse_text: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: So the Jebusites are still living right there among the Benjamites when this was written.
cards.verse_text: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: So the Israelites keep living among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: Thus the Israelites continued to live among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: …Israelites continued to live among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: David and his men march against the Jebusites who live there, and I don't think the Jebusites are worried one bit.
cards.verse_text: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land.
cards.snippet: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land.

cards.card_text: As David and his men march on Jerusalem, the Jebusites tell David that even the blind and lame can repel him.
cards.verse_text: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land.
cards.snippet: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land.

cards.card_text: On that day, David says whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft to reach the lame and blind who are despised by David.
cards.verse_text: On that day he said, “Whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft to reach the lame and blind who are despised by David.” That is why it is said, “The blind and the lame will never enter the palace.”
cards.snippet: On that day he said, “Whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft to reach the lame and blind who…

cards.card_text: These are the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites left in the land, the ones the Israelites were unable to devote to destruction.
cards.verse_text: As for all the people who remained of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites (the people who were not Israelites)— their descendants who remained in the land, those whom the Israelites were unable to devote to destruction—Solomon conscripted these people to be forced laborers, as they are to this day.
cards.snippet: …all the people who remained of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites (the people who were not Israelites)— their descendants who remained in the…

cards.card_text: The Jebusites live in the land.
cards.verse_text: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus), where the Jebusites inhabited the land.
cards.snippet: …and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus), where the Jebusites inhabited the land.

cards.card_text: Even Ekron will be like the Jebusites, the people who ended up living among Judah in Jerusalem (Joshua 15:63).
cards.verse_text: Then they too will become a remnant for our God; they will become like a clan in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.
cards.snippet: …become like a clan in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.
